description.narrative: This action aims at contributing to improve the conditions for justice reforms in the IPA III beneficiaries. Through justice perception surveys complemented by in-depth analytical reports and awareness-raising, the action will (1) enhance conditions for targeted reforms in the justice system of each IPA III beneficiary and (2) enhance participation of justice users in assessing performance of justice systems in each IPA III beneficiary.
